name: Plants
overview: Scripture reveals that plants are a deliberate creation of God, brought forth by His command to yield seed and fruit according to their kinds, as seen in Genesis 1:11-12. God generously provides every herb and fruit-bearing tree for human nourishment, emphasizing His provision and care (Genesis 1:29; 9:3). The Psalms further illustrate the sustaining and fruitful nature of plants, portraying the godly as flourishing like a well-watered tree and highlighting that God causes grass and herbs to grow for both animals and human benefit (Psalms 1:3; 104:14). These passages affirm plants as a vital part of God's good creation, sustaining life and symbolizing spiritual vitality.
